title: Small Resultant Systems via Linear Combinations
summary: For a system of $s$ homogeneous polynomials of degree $d$ in $n$ variables, say ${\bf{f}} = 0$, we consider the problem of constructing resultant systems. A resultant system is a finite set of polynomials in the coefficients of the input polynomials, the vanishing of which characterizes the systems $\bf{f}$ with a common non-zero solution. The classical approaches for constructing resultant systems rely either on maximal minors of large coefficient matrices or on the coefficients of a resultant of generic linear combinations of the input polynomials.
